overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long BTDR Daily ETF (BTDL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Bitdeer Technologies Group (NASDAQ: BTDR) stock. BTDL was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.

data.title: Leveraged ETFs: From Megacaps to Micro Trends
data.text: Single-stock leveraged ETFs were unusual when they first arrived in the U.S. market just four years ago. Today, it might be hard to find a stock without one.

data.title: GraniteShares Launches NTAL, TDCL and BTDL, 2x Long ETFs on NetApp, Teradata and Bitdeer
data.text: New single-stock ETFs give investors amplified leveraged daily participation tied to NetApp, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTAP), Teradata Corporation (NYSE: TDC) and Bitdeer Technologies Group (NASDAQ: BTDR).
